reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png mascot reference; checked hair, brows, facial hair, one mouth, eyewear, clothing, pose, crop, lighting, collar, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: Short dark-brown hair brushed back with a side part and receding temples, plus dark eyebrows, remains visible. The narrow source-scale upper-lip detail has not expanded into a broad moustache or beard; the chin is smooth and there is one serious closed mouth, with no added glasses. The three-quarter turn and gaze toward viewer left, formal upper-chest crop and warm directional cheek lighting are retained. One dark olive notched-lapel jacket, pale-gray shirt and one dark patterned tie remain. The pale collar closes naturally around a short broad yellow neck beneath the rounded chin, without a long column, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with faint upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior with no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; values 252-254 were not used as a rejection shortcut, and no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact narrow upper-lip detail and fine tie/collar pattern cannot be classified microscopically; the review confirms only the visible source-scale shapes and no clear broad facial-hair addition. The note's gray marks remain indistinct visual groups, not readable text.
